objective: Measure whether the largest remaining residue class - wrong characters, dominated by variant-form choices that full-page reading cannot resolve - is decidable at glyph-crop resolution. Every single-character disagreement between the stored champion (toolbelt v2) outputs and MTHv2 real gold is re-posed as a blind forced choice on the character's own gold-annotated crop, enlarged. Gold-box localization deliberately isolates decidability from localization; a production pass would substitute RF-DETR detector boxes.
hypothesis: A majority of the wrong class resolves to the gold form at crop resolution (the information is on the page, just below full-page reading resolution), while controls stay unbroken - making a production glyph-adjudication pass the highest-value instrument toward perfect pages.
instrument_choice: Model forced choice on the enlarged crop (gemini-3.6-flash, temperature 0, minimal thinking, schema-bound A/B/neither/illegible, seeded A/B assignment balanced 571/1131 so no position or identity leaks gold). The char_inventory exemplar library was evaluated and rejected as an instrument: its index carries crop geometry only - zero text labels - so no labeled exemplar exists for any variant pair, and cross-corpus manuscript-to-print pixel matching has no trained matcher.

instances.control_design: Agreement positions whose character has a measured confusion counterpart; the adjudicator is offered the true form against the counterpart. A flip is a measured break - the overcorrection risk v4 demonstrated at page level.
instances.coverage_note: 931 CJK disagreements + 5 skipped non-CJK = exactly the 936 wrong characters of the v2 autopsy; 1126 of 1131 boxes are true char-level annotations, 5 interpolated from line geometry.

metrics.fix_rate: fraction of resolved disagreements adjudicated to the gold form
metrics.break_rate: fraction of resolved controls flipped away from the true form
metrics.patched_recall: real per-page sequence recall after applying adjudicated fixes to the stored outputs (not a projection)

gates.net: patched recall mean strictly above the stored 0.8466 v2 mean
gates.budget_stop: adjudicate --max-cost stops before the next call at the ceiling

non_goals: No production recipe, suite, or gold edits.
No station code changes; this is an instrument measurement, not a harness build.
next_permitted_action: Run adjudicate over the full manifest under the declared budget, then score fixes, breaks, and patched recall.
